notes.title: 0.4000 Update news!
notes.content:
Hello, everyone!
This update is a big change.
Please check below for details!

[h1]12 Gods[/h1]
The quests related to 12 Gods and 12 Gods have been removed.

[h1]Hunger system[/h1]
The hunger system has been added.
You can turn hunger on and off in Options.
Within the game, the right blue UI represents the hungry UI.
If your hunger is below zero, you'll see the grim reaper!


[h1]Fatigue[/h1]
If you don't sleep until late at night, you will faint because you are tired.


[h1]Class system[/h1]
The class is added.
Classes can be bought on the bulletin board in the middle of the village.
The class limit has been added to the clothes.


[h1]Town[/h1]
You can check town funds on the town's central bulletin board.
More maps are available depending on the village's funding.


[h1]Clothes[/h1]
Three men's and three women's hanboks have been added.
You can live with the villagers Eunwol.

tags.feature: The hunger system has been added.
The class is added.
Three men's and three women's hanboks have been added.

Hello, everyone!
In this update, we have increased the number of Placing items, etc items, monster book, and user convenience.
Please check below for more details!


[b][h1]Placing Items[/h1][/b]
Multiple placing items have been added.

[b][h1]ETC Items[/h1][/b]
[olist]
[*] Silk Worm
[*] Silk
[*] Pea Oil
[*] Corn Oil
[*] GrapeSeed Oil
[*] CharCoal
[*] Egg Mushroom
[*] YangSongi Mushroom
[/olist]

[b][h1]Monster Book[/h1][/b]
When you catch a monster through an empty generation marble, it is shown in the Monster Book.
The Monster Book shows detailed information about the Monster.
As further updates add more monsters, more will be added to the monster as well.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35027027/48bd6b91a10aa2151f3f7f41afe4370f2d7515f2.jpg[/img]

[b][h1]other Update[/h1][/b]
[list]
[*] When you gave a present to an old monster, you could continue to reduce your favorability by giving him a gift you don't like, but now you can only cut it once a day. Also, the favorability does not fall below zero.
[*] The door and light status are now Saveable.
[*] The mini-map now shows NPC in yellow, animal, and monster in purple.
[/list]
